data.name: Ikhtiyaar
data.gender_notes: Ikhtiyaar is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ikhtiyaar is a name derived from the Arabic root 'khtr' meaning 'to choose'. In Islamic context, it refers to the concept of Allah's infinite wisdom and ability to choose the best for His creation. This name signifies the importance of making righteous choices in life. The name Ikhtiyaar carries the meaning “To choose, select, prefer” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ikhtiyaar usually hope their child will grow to embody to choose, select, prefer and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Choosing the right path guided by Allah's wisdom
data.etymology: Ikhtiyaar belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “To choose, select, prefer.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ikhtiyaar total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
